historical_record.description: Two earthquake relief shacks — one Type B, one Type A — were joined into the L-shaped house that stands here. The Type B shack faces the street, with a boxed bay window under its front gable; the elevations are clad in wood shingles and one original three-by-two divided-light casement window survives on the east side.
